highlights_headline: The 4.150.6 snapshot improves Ganesh handling of failed render tasks and buffer uploads.

bullets.detail: Separates whether a task executed from whether it succeeded so native flush handling can recognize task and intermediate submission failures. Existing managed flush signatures are unchanged.

Adds checks that reject affected draws after GPU buffer upload failures under memory pressure and retains CPU triangulation data for later upload attempts; this does not establish complete upload-failure coverage.
